source.title: Field efficacy of novel fungicides against chickpea rust (Uromyces ciceris-arietini)

quote: two sprays of 0.1% azoxystrobin 18.2% + difenoconazole 11.4% sc fungicide at 15 days interval minimizes the rust severity to the tune of >77%
note: ICAR-IIPR Dharwad 2019-21; fills chickpea rust advisory gap

source.title: Field evaluation of different fungicides against Uromyces ciceris-arietini causing rust in chickpea in northern Karnataka

quote: less percent disease index was observed in spray with Tebuconazole 50%+ Trifloxystrobin 25% w/w 75WG @ 0.5 g/l water and it was found effective in managing the disease with 15.81%

source.title: In vivo Evaluation of Fungicides against Chickpea Rust Caused by Uromyces ciceris-arietini

quote: Among the eight fungicides tested, the least PDI was observed in Propiconazole (25.84 PDI) followed by Hexaconzole (27.16 PDI) and Difenconazole (29.58 PDI). ... Propiconazole, Hexaconzole and Difenconazole can be used for the effective control of chickpea rust at 0.1%.
